items.information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) - [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com) - *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* - We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. - Competitors and spectators under the age of 18 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian. - West Coast Cubing does not provide supervision and cannot assume responsibility for personal safety or belongings.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjA5ODA2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--18c8e034533abcb263edde1f5e2c529188113070/2027-cubing-rain-2027-logo-no-bg2.jpg) [*DE*] **Willkommen zu Cubing in the Rain 2027!** Wir freuen uns auf einen kalten, regnerischen Tag voller spannender Solves. **Zuschauer und Gäste sind sehr willkommen!** [*EN*] **Welcome to Cubing in the Rain 2027!** We’re looking forward to a cold, rainy day full of exciting solves. **Spectators and Guests are very welcome**

items.information: Oldham County Winter 2027 is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBak44IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5480638ed1b138c4bbe41a46a7e7dbb34d1406e2/MCA-Final-Logo%20(WCA%20website%20version).png) Oldham County Winter 2027 will be done in a stationary format, this format will be explained before the competition starts, and during the newcomer tutorial.
